title: Lecturer on Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Juan F. Peña Cardelles has served as a part-time lecturer in the Department of Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences at Harvard School of Dental Medicine since 2022. He completed an implant dentistry fellowship at the University of Connecticut within the divisions of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery and Prosthodontics as an ITI Scholarship recipient. Peña Cardelles is board-certified by the European Board of Oral Surgery and also serves as faculty in the postgraduate program in Oral Surgery and Implant Dentistry at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos in Madrid, Spain. His research interests focus on oral surgery and implant dentistry, and he has contributed to the peer-reviewed literature in these areas.
